{{Ophiuchus}}
Ophiuchus 9 is the 345th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 9th day of Ophiuchus, and it is a Tuesday. It corresponds to ISO week 50, weekday 2.

Its informal Japanese name is 13宮9日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 345|Chapter 345]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152364}}.
